changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter procedure api.CompleteExecution @executionId int, @date datetime, @errorMessage nvarchar(2500) as begin set nocount on; update E set E.ErrorMessage = @errorMessage, E.[State] = 4, E.CompletedOn = @date, E.[Total] = iif(Tc.Cnt = 0, E.[Total], Tc.Cnt), E.Processed = iif(Pc.Cnt = 0, E.Processed, Pc.Cnt), E.[Error] = iif(Ec.Cnt = 0, E.[Error], Ec.Cnt) from api.Execution E cross apply ( select count(1) as Cnt from api.ExecutionItem where ExecutionId = @executionId and Success = 0 ) Ec cross apply ( select count(1) as Cnt from api.ExecutionItem where ExecutionId = @executionId and Success = 1 ) Pc cross apply ( select count(1) as Cnt from api.ExecutionItem where ExecutionId = @executionId ) Tc where E.Id = @executionId; end
